author: MLGtino
body:
Remove Flare, add Scorpio. (Nexus)

Flare: Lags like hell. Any player without a good computer can't play on this map. And the glass coating is just plain stupid and gives me a headache (I'm sorry but it does). It shouldn't be in the rots. But...

What we should do: Replace it with Scorpio. Why was it removed? It was honestly a good map. Spawn killing was a problem, but who says that can't be fixed? We can:

Highlight and expand the underground tunnels more.

Make safer and easier ways to exit the spawns.

Fix the little nooks and crannies people can hide and get stuck in.

Anyone agree, or is it just me being a bit self-centered again?

replies.author: Mango_
replies.body:
Yeah I have to agree. As nice as Flare looks as a build, I don't think it's really suitable for Nexus gameplay. The stained glass is a pain too :/

I would also love to see Scorpio make a come back - I really enjoyed playing on that map. With a few tweaks made to those aspects you mentioned, I believe it should definitely be put back in the rotations!
